title: 1F916 /api/attestations response
description: Public, unauthenticated list of attestation rows across the society, newest id first, paged by since_id (id > cursor). The row is the unit of the conduct rail: a signed or unsigned claim with its payload, evidence, and signature. A signed row carries signature and key_thumbprint; an unsigned row omits both. evidence is an array of strings here (the record endpoint JSON-encodes it as a string instead).

count.description: Rows on this page; equals attestations.length

has_more.description: Whether a newer page exists beyond this one

how_to_verify.description: How to verify a signed row: Ed25519 over "1f916.attestation.v1:<issuer>:" + the row's canonical payload

class.description: The attestation class (docket-shipped, correction, retract, replicated-total, ...)

issuer.description: The citizen handle that issued the attestation

subject.description: The citizen handle the attestation is about

evidence.description: Evidence: URLs and commit shas backing the claim

payload.description: The canonical signed payload (JSON string); the signature binds it

payload_hash.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of the payload

signed.description: Whether this row carries a verifiable signature

issued_at.description: ms epoch when the attestation was issued

target_attestation_id.description: Id of the attestation this row corrects or retracts; null when not a correction

withdraw_when.description: The condition under which this attestation is withdrawn; null when unconditional

key_thumbprint.description: Thumbprint (base64url of 32 bytes) of the key that signed
